items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: they were talking about Hillard looks at the same subject... Murphy and says, 'what the hell are they talking about?'

ctx.x: And myself. And George is in the back, and I don't know who he's with. But they were talking about Hillard looks at the same subject, about having a seance and all that. Murphy and says, 'what the hell are they talking about?' I says, 'I don't know, they didn't give me any.'
